title: High-Voltage Battery and Expansion Valve Issues
summary: This topic mainly groups brief mentions of high-voltage battery behavior, charging, and cooling-system expansion valve issues, with only a few clearly negative examples and many fragments lacking enough context for firm sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe permanent failure of the hybrid high-voltage battery expansion valve and repeated low-voltage battery malfunction warnings.

mixed.summary: The mixed review mentions the same permanent failure wording for the hybrid high-voltage battery expansion valve, but the fragment alone does not show both positive and negative aspects clearly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include technical battery and voltage references, charging expectations, and service discussions that do not provide enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are short technical notes or partial service descriptions, so sentiment is often unclear.
